summary: This plugin for dsh automates custom provider model configuration by filling missing reasoning and model metadata and adjusting protocol compatibility fields for route behavior.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is a dsh host extension that automates model-provider configuration for custom LLM routes. Based on the repository description, it listens for adapter/settings updates and applies local settings mutations so custom providers expose reasoning effort levels and have compatible metadata defaults, then manages protocol-specific `compat` fields. Its effects are configuration-level (local model metadata and compatibility behavior) with no separate code-generation, search, or UI-building capability shown in the evidence.
